descricao_original: The large intestine, composed of the four basic tunics, is differentiated from small intestine by the lack of villi, straight intestinal glands and taeniae coli. The large intestine is the site of water absorption and fecal formation. The large intestine was cut in cross section in the top left image and longitudinally through a taenia coli in the bottom left image. 10x, 10x
